intended_use: Clinician-facing medication education and safety review for dentistry and gynecology.
activation_requirements: Qualified specialty clinician review for each entry and the whole catalogue.
Official/current source and jurisdiction verified; version and review due date recorded.
Clinical pharmacy review of interaction, contraindication, allergy, dose, pregnancy and lactation rules.
Evaluation set signed off by clinical governance and software/regulatory review completed.
Production authentication, authorization, audit, privacy, security and change-control controls deployed.
